name: Dust Proof AC Cover Set for 1 Ton | Non-Waterproof Non-Woven Fabric | Indoor & Outdoor Protection (2 Pcs)
description:
Protect your air conditioner from dust, dirt, and debris with this 2 pcs AC Dust Proof Cover Set designed for 1 Ton wall-mounted units. Made from 50 GSM non-woven material, it shields both the indoor and outdoor units when not in use. The elastic edges ensure a snug fit, while the lightweight, washable fabric makes it easy to reuse and maintain. Ideal for prolonging the life of your AC and keeping it clean during off-season.Key Features:
 2 pcs set for indoor & outdoor AC units
 50 GSM non-woven fabric for dust protection
 Elastic edges for quick, tool-free installation
 Washable, reusable, lightweight, and durable
 Suitable for 1 Ton (88–95cm) split AC unitsHow to Use:
1⃣ Ensure AC is switched off and dry.
2⃣ Stretch the elastic cover and place over indoor/outdoor unit.
3⃣ Adjust the edges for full coverage.
4⃣ Remove before switching on the AC.Safety Information:
 Do not use while the AC is running.
 Keep away from heat sources.
 Wash gently and air dry only.

Package Includes:
 1 × Indoor AC Dust Cover (1 Ton)
 1 × Outdoor AC Dust Cover (1 Ton)
